a.xlink:title: Sets up the style, theme resources and shared theme actions.
Changes the application theme and updates the shared actions.
Returns the shared action for a theme.
Applies the selected theme's effective background and refreshes palettes and dynamic icons.
Emits a pending theme notification after updates have finished.
Returns the theme name for logging.
Notifies listeners when the effective background changes.
Returns whether Windows uses a dark application theme.
Updates an action's icon for the selected theme.
Notifies listeners when the selected theme changes.
Creates a themed icon, falling back to original normal-mode pixmaps for missing resources.
Copies the normal-mode pixmaps for one icon state.
Finds a theme-specific icon resource, falling back to the default resource.
Creates the colors, palette and pens for a dark or light theme.
